verdict_ko: 확인된 설정 결함과 진단 기록의 결함은 찾았다. 그러나 세 번의 실제 실패를 하나의 확정 원인으로 연결할 증거는 보존되지 않았다. 1·2차는 시작 경로 완료 후 출력 프로토콜 단계에서 실패했고, 3차는 controller의 PermissionError만 남아 정확한 실패 연산과 모델 실행 여부가 불명이다.

attempts.proven: The counter increments only after _JSONLTransport construction returns; suspended process creation, Job assignment and resume therefore returned successfully. A successful model response was not obtained.
attempts.not_proven: The user-reported EOF/no output has no retained byte/frame/exit diagnostics for this attempt. The underlying reason for missing protocol completion is unknown. The prompt latch is set BEFORE writing stdin and does not acknowledge provider processing.
attempts.configuration: The invalid tools.view_image=false override was present. It is a confirmed command defect, but this attempt retained no stderr evidence tying its failure to that key.

attempts.proven: Startup returned successfully; no stdout protocol frame was received before EOF. The retained stderr classifier found a configuration-related substring. tools.view_image=false was invalid for the pinned Codex 0.163.0 schema and strict CLI override loader.
attempts.assessment: Configuration rejection is the best-supported explanation, and the invalid override is a concrete defect. The exact rejected key and whether it was the only blocker cannot be established from the retained coarse hint.
attempts.not_proven: Raw 98-byte stderr, error kind/key and natural exit status were not retained. A null pre-cleanup exit is not exit 0; forced cleanup exit is not a natural exit. Two different synthetic errors reproduce these same coarse counters.

attempts.proven: The worker reached reservation, after controller setup and agent registration. The controller outer BaseException handler reduced its own exception to its class name. No original operation, traceback stage, errno or winerror was retained.
attempts.not_proven: The provider subprocess might or might not have started. Missing counters cannot be defaulted to zero. The class name does not establish a Codex OS permission failure or an ACL problem.
attempts.actor_boundary: A worker exception does not cross the subprocess boundary as a raw controller exception: the normal nonzero worker path becomes Abort(cli_nonzero). A failed worker finalization can leave reserved, but does not alone explain the controller PermissionError.
source_exclusions: The private setup directory is created before the outer try; its creation failure cannot directly produce this observed caught report after reservation.
Agent configuration creation precedes the observed agent/token/reservation progress.
Journal stop handling and private directory removal run in finally with separate exception handling; they do not directly set the outer caught error_code.
Current transport start wraps OSError/ProcessCleanupError into AdapterError(runtime_unavailable); its exception class is not directly the controller PermissionError.

interpretation: A silent process can exit 0 after a completed pipe write and still yield runtime_outcome_unknown: successful OS exit is not successful JSONL completion.

Two different synthetic configuration messages padded to 98 bytes yield the same coarse historical diagnostics; detailed classification distinguishes their keys. These messages were fabricated and are not recovered stderr.

Injected create, Job assignment and resume failures return runtime_unavailable with transport counter 0. A Job/resume failure may occur AFTER a suspended native process exists; zero transport count alone is not zero OS creations.

Injected temporary workspace creation denial produces PermissionError before transport; the actual third reservation alone cannot identify the stage, and the controller/worker actor boundary still applies.
An open dummy reader causes frozen worker os.replace to fail (errno 13 / winerror 5); the controller can still read the old reserved row.

A controlled exclusive dummy file handle causes the frozen controller safe/read handler to produce PermissionError + reserved both before and after a confirmed fresh synthetic transport run. The ledger was deliberately left reserved to model interrupted finalization; this is not a claim that the original trial had the same lock.
